policy: Restart PASS requires: (A) writing checkpoints leaves the continuous forecast bit-identical to the original; (B) a run resumed from the candidate's own checkpoint reproduces the original's histories exactly, and the ordered (time,dt) steps after the checkpoint. If B differs, compare against an original-executable resume before any verdict. No relaxed exactness.

seg_a_quilted.result: FAIL at first checkpoint (07:00, step 185): quilt servers 496-503 'Possible 32-bit overflow on output server' (stock module_io_quilt_old.F 32-bit MPI_INTEGER obufsize reduce); production 4x8 quilt layout cannot write quilted restart files for this domain. Not optimization-caused.

seg_a_split.result: PASS: offline unchanged wrf_exact comparator, four histories 06-09 exact vs original corrected forecast; 545 (time,dt) steps identical

seg_b.cause: dyn_em/start_em.F:1032 passes allowed=.NOT.restart; tools/cpu-memory/thompson-table-sharing/thompson_tpi_bridge.c:16 sets bad=1 whenever !allowed, even when sharing is not requested (mode 0) -> ST_ARGUMENT -> wrf_error_fatal. Any WRF_EXPERIMENTAL_TPI_NUMA build (selected 352f, clean build, HEAD) cannot restart.
seg_b.proposed_fix: When !allowed, force private mode (mode=0, as the original non-shared table path) instead of rejecting; keep rejection for bad OMP settings and cross-rank disagreement. Shared tables stay first-start only.

selected_352f.reason: Thompson TPI/TNI shared tables are restricted by design to cold single-domain starts (tools/cpu-memory/thompson-table-sharing/BUILD_WIRING.json runtime_restriction; restart listed in acceptance_pending). The 352f seg B abort is that guard, not a defect.
selected_352f.withdrawn_fix: A private-fallback bridge change was drafted and reverted: it contradicts the documented no-silent-fallback rule and was never exercised (r4 does not compile TPI).

seg_b.result_08: Every variable and raw value identical to the original continuous 08:00 history; sole strict difference: global attribute START_DATE (restart segment start). This is exactly the single pre-specified restart metadata exception in prospective-policy-draft.md.

canonical_clean_build.memory: Canonical no-TPI build peaks ~86-88 GiB anonymous per node in a continuous 3h run vs ~46-48 GiB for selected 352f (shared Thompson tables); restart adds buffers and exceeds the 100 GiB cap.

seg_c.harness: model SUCCESS COMPLETE; coordinator post-run field_view_admission requires all four writer roots active, a one-output segment activates one (harness structural, not science)

canonical_clean_build.steps: Resumed (time,dt) sequences identical to the original: 360/360 steps 07:00:20-09:00 (seg B) and 180/180 steps 08:00:20-09:00 (seg C).
canonical_clean_build.verdict: PASS for the canonical (no-TPI) build: writing split checkpoints leaves the forecast exact; resuming from either checkpoint reproduces every field and every adaptive step of the continuous forecast; the only metadata difference is START_DATE, the single exception pre-specified in prospective-policy-draft.md.
canonical_clean_build.limits: Split restart only (io_form_restart=102); quilted restart is impossible in this 4x8 I/O layout (stock 32-bit overflow). The 07->09 resume lost its 09:00 file to the 100 GiB cap; 09:00 was verified from the 08:00 resume instead. Not full-144, not other decompositions.

next: Selected TPI configuration needs designed restart support (documented acceptance_pending) before any restart claim; memory headroom for canonical build restart (~97 GiB anon) is marginal under the 100 GiB cap.
